title: STATIC NIGHT SHIFT -- offline hardening only. No runtime, no science decisions.
purpose: Make the next live run boring, mechanically witnessed and hard to misinterpret, without running it. Not to make Silicon Arena look successful. Make it harder for Silicon Arena to lie.
rule: Do ONE queue item per turn. Verify it, commit it, write status.json. If an item is already done, say so and move to the next; do not pad. Prefer finishing an item properly over touching several.
queue: ITEM 1: static audit of the runtime-memory and recovery code paths (tools/runtime_memory.gd, scripts/arena/recovery_action.gd, scripts/arena/recovery_gate.gd, tools/backend_continuity.py). Read them; write findings to docs/results/STATIC_AUDIT_RUNTIME_RECOVERY.md as a list of concrete defects or 'no defect found' per path. Do NOT fix anything in this turn -- separating finding from fixing is the point.

ITEM 2: harden artifact schemas. Every JSON artifact a result depends on should declare what it is and be rejected if it does not. Extend the schema checks, add teeth that prove a malformed artifact is refused.
ITEM 3: expand tools/result_loader.py fail-closed coverage. For each new refusal branch, add a test that PROVES it refuses -- a branch with no test does not count as coverage.

ITEM 4: write docs/RERUN_ABC_PROCEDURE.md: the exact, ordered, copy-pasteable procedure for rerunning RUNTIME-MEMORY arms IDLE, CONTROL_WORKLOAD and RECOVERY_ONLY with corrected telemetry, including every precondition, every witness that must be GREEN, and the explicit STOP conditions. Writing the procedure is permitted; executing it is NOT.

ITEM 5: review EVERY test suite for hidden runtime contact. For each suite in tools/run_safe_tests.py, justify its NO_CONTACT / CONTACT_REQUIRED / STATE_MUTATING classification against what the file actually does. Record the audit in docs/results/CONTACT_CLASSIFICATION_AUDIT.md. Misclassification found = fix the classification, never the boundary.

ITEM 6: improve sabotage coverage. Find teeth that are asserted but never proven to bite, and add a sabotage that proves each one. A sabotage must assert it actually applied before running, and must be reverted. NO_CONTACT suites only.
ITEM 7: bring docs/NEXT_LIVE_RUN.md current with everything above -- ESTABLISHED / UNRESOLVED / INVALIDATED / NEXT PERMITTED LIVE ACTION.

ITEM 8: write docs/results/STATIC_SHIFT_REPORT.md: commits, tests, bugs found, sabotages proven, what was deliberately NOT done, and unresolved blockers. Report failures and dead ends as prominently as successes. Then DONE.

boundaries.lm_studio: READ-ONLY / DO-NOT-CONTACT. No restart, unload/load, inference, or experiment runs. This is enforced by the execution path, not just this sentence: your Bash allowlist cannot reach the runtime.
boundaries.tests: Run ONLY via: python tools/run_safe_tests.py, with no arguments. If you author a new test suite you MUST register and classify it in that runner -- an unclassified test-shaped file fails the discovery audit and will halt the shift.
boundaries.no_science_decisions: You may not change any acceptance criterion, threshold, seed set, gate verdict logic, or statistical rule. Specifically frozen: ks=1.8, kh=20, n=3, the 2048 MB RAM floor, the coherence gate's 0.2 and its seeds 1..20, and every preregistration in docs/results/. If a gate looks wrong, WRITE THAT DOWN as a finding. Do not fix it.
boundaries.no_reinterpretation: UNKNOWN is never upgraded to PASS. The quarantined qwen block stays unanalysed for causal inference. Quarantined and VOID results stay quarantined and VOID. Do not rescue a failed experiment because the numbers look interesting.
boundaries.no_deletion: Delete nothing. Not Run 1, not artifacts, not models, not history. Superseded documents are amended, not removed.
boundaries.do_not_touch: PIT A and SWARM/METABOLISM experimental results. The monorepo -- all work stays in this repository.
boundaries.honesty: If you break something, report it in the commit message rather than quietly correcting it. A boundary violation must be reported, not buried.

stop_when.DONE: all eight queue items are committed
stop_when.BLOCKED: cannot proceed without violating a boundary
stop_when.HUMAN_CLEARANCE_REQUIRED: the next action needs runtime contact, or a scientific judgement that is not yours to make -- including any decision about the coherence detector's marginal region, which belongs to a future COHERENCE-MARGIN experiment and not to this shift
